description: hugoh/hk-config//renovate.json is extended here so every consumer gets its custom managers (the hugoh/hk-config and jdx/hk pins in *.pkl / mise.toml) and its global disable of the built-in mise manager for `hk`. Repos with no hk.pkl are unaffected — those managers just match nothing. Since ~every repo uses hk.pkl, this is injected in the base rather than opted into per repo.

packageRules.description: First-party reusable workflows and composite actions: a bump only reaches consumers once a new tag is cut, so propagate within a day and automerge. Restricted to the repos that own these workflows/actions. Needs its own groupName so it isn't swallowed into the "non-major updates" group above, which would otherwise pull in the base schedule:monthly instead of "at any time".
